_comment: Client roster. Every run checks each Trending-now entry and each Calendar entry against every brand below and writes a brand line only where the fit is honest. `fits` are themes that make a match; `never` are hard stops; `watch_for` are search terms to run each day for the brand's own moments and mentions. Dates and facts about a brand are never taken from this file — verify them from a source fetched that day.

brands.name: BMW Singapore
never: car fires, crashes, recalls or anything where a car is the victim
COE jokes that mock people who can't afford a car
claims about specs, prices or offers not on a BMW Singapore page fetched that day

brands.name: Dunkin' Donuts Singapore
never: food-safety stories about any outlet
halal or religion-linked food stories
naming a competitor in a put-down

brands.name: IKEA Singapore
fits: moving house, BTO keys, HDB resale and rental news
school holidays and family days out
never: property-price rage or cooling-measure politics
punching down on people who can't afford homes
product safety or recall stories

brands.name: AIA Singapore
fits: haze and health advisories (factual, caring tone)
never: deaths, accidents, illness or tragedy of any kind — insurers never post into loss
promises of payouts, returns or cover in a trendjack line
anything MAS would read as financial advice

brands.name: Orchard Road Business Association (ORBA)
fits: Orchard Road events, light-ups and closures
festive seasons (Christmas on A Great Street)
retail openings and closures on the belt
never: taking a side between member malls or tenants
closures framed as 'Orchard is dying'

brands.name: The Centrepoint
fits: school holidays and family days out
never: mocking another mall
incidents at any mall

brands.name: Tiong Bahru Plaza
fits: school holidays and family days out
never: mocking another mall
incidents at any mall

brands.name: Hougang Mall
fits: school holidays and family days out
never: mocking another mall
incidents at any mall
Hougang as a political constituency

brands.name: Samsung Singapore
fits: phone launches and upgrade season (react to rivals with wit, not attacks)
photography and night shots (F1, light-ups, fireworks)
home appliances in haze and heat
never: battery, fire or safety stories about any device
naming Apple or any rival in a put-down
specs or prices not on a Samsung SG page fetched that day

brands.name: Ferrari (Singapore)
fits: F1 Singapore Grand Prix and Scuderia Ferrari race results
never: humour, memes or discounts of any kind
COE or cost-of-living tie-ins
any trend that isn't motorsport or design — restraint is the brand

brands.name: Rolls-Royce Motor Cars Asia Pacific
fits: major cultural festivals handled with ceremony (Mid-Autumn, CNY, Deepavali)
never: humour, memes, discounts or trendjacks off news
any cost, COE or wealth-gap story
F1 — it isn't the brand's sport

brands.name: MINI Singapore
fits: parking, small spaces and tight corners
never: crashes or road incidents
COE jokes that mock people who can't afford a car

brands.name: HYROX
never: medical emergencies at any race
mocking athletes or participants

brands.name: AIA Ultimate FitnessFest (AUFF)
fits: festival countdown once dates are confirmed
never: same hard stops as AIA — nothing into injury, illness or loss
medical emergencies at any race

brands.name: Maersk Air Cargo
fits: supply-chain disruption that affects SG shoppers (factual)
product launches that depend on air freight (phones, perishables)
never: consumer meme formats
disasters, crashes or conflict-driven disruption
commenting on a customer's or competitor's delays

brands.name: UOB
fits: scam-awareness when a scam wave is trending
never: promises of returns, rates or approvals in a trendjack line
jokes about anyone losing money or being scammed
politics, ministerial pay or government policy

brands.name: OSIM Singapore
fits: World Mental Health Day (rest, not treatment)
never: medical or treatment claims
injury stories
